Vengeful Cambions are a type of Fiend and non-playable race in Baldur's Gate 3.
“
Crafted from a soul indebted to Raphael, these cambions have pupils that dilate with devotion whenever he is near.
„
— In-game racial description

About Vengeful Cambions

Typically found in the Hells, Vengeful Cambions are half-fiend, half-mortal, and are resistant to many types of damage. They assist Raphael in defending the House of Hope.
